# Vendored: Sotechy's store-token contract

`SotechyTokens.sol` is copied **unchanged** from [Sotechy-App](https://github.com/soke-dev/Sotechy-App/blob/main/packages/contracts/src/SotechyTokens.sol) (commit `937494c`), where it predates this project. It's here so the escrow can be tested and deployed with it on X Layer, where the escrow is added as one more operator and mints a store's tokens only when an order's money is released.

It isn't part of the Build X work; everything else in `contracts/` is.
